name: you_had_to_be_there
style_suffix: 1970s home-movie aesthetic, Super 8 film look, warm faded color palette, heavy film grain, soft focus, slight halation and gentle light leaks, slightly overexposed, vignette, period-accurate 1970s American detail, nostalgic and intimate, shot on vintage film stock
default_music_prompt: Warm, wistful nostalgic underscore for a gentle documentary about growing up in 1970s America. Soft acoustic guitar and mellow electric piano, warm analog pads, slow unhurried tempo. Bittersweet and tender, never grand, never mournful. Light and reminiscent, leaving plenty of room for a narrator. No heavy percussion, no big swells.

thumbnail.candidate_prompt_suffix: YouTube thumbnail composition, one strong nostalgic focal subject massed in the RIGHT TWO-THIRDS of the frame, rich saturated warm period color, high contrast, the LEFT THIRD deliberately darker, shadowed, low-detail negative space reserved for a headline, cinematic and inviting, single subject only, no clutter, no human faces, no text, no letters
selection_rules: ONE instantly-readable nostalgic subject that reads at phone-thumbnail size
warm, rich, high-contrast color that pops in a dim feed without looking fake
clean, darker negative space in the TOP-LEFT where the headline lands
no garbled detail, no accidental letterforms, no broken objects, no faces
boldly nostalgic but emotionally honest — intrigue, not a lie
